title: High-Order Liquid Evidence Modeling for Continuous and Subtle GNSS Spoofing Detection in Autonomous Driving
abstract: arXiv:2609.26231v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continuous and subtle GNSS spoofing poses a serious threat to autonomous vehicles because forged positions may remain locally plausible while gradually becoming inconsistent with vehicle motion observed by non-GNSS onboard sensors. Existing AV-oriented detectors commonly rely on residual thresholds or feature-level classification and provide limited modeling of how weak GNSS--motion inconsistency develops and persists over time. This paper formulates subtle GNSS spoofing detection as a causal sequential evidence-modeling problem and proposes a high-order liquid evidence detector. The method first compares the displacement implied by consecutive GNSS positions with that inferred from independent onboard motion observations and converts their difference into uncertainty-normalized residual evidence. translated_title: 面向自动驾驶中连续且隐蔽GNSS欺骗检测的高阶液体证据建模
translated_abstract: 连续且隐蔽的GNSS欺骗对自动驾驶车辆构成严重威胁，因为伪造的定位可能在局部保持合理，同时逐渐与车载非GNSS传感器观测到的车辆运动产生不一致。现有面向自动驾驶的检测器通常依赖残差阈值或特征级分类，对微弱的GNSS与运动之间不一致性如何随时间发展和持续缺乏充分建模。本文将隐蔽GNSS欺骗检测形式化为一个因果序列证据建模问题，并提出一种高阶液体证据检测器。该方法首先将连续GNSS位置所隐含的位移与由独立的车载运动观测推断出的位移进行比较，并将其差异转换为经不确定性归一化的残差证据。随后，该方法对当前的不一致性、其局部演化、超出正常水平的程度、累积的持续性以及位移变化进行表征（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出一种高阶液体证据检测器，将隐蔽GNSS欺骗检测形式化为因果序列证据建模问题，通过不确定性归一化的残差证据对GNSS与运动不一致性的演化、超标及累积持续性进行高阶建模，从而实现对自动驾驶中连续隐蔽GNSS欺骗的有效检测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a high-order liquid evidence detector that formulates subtle GNSS spoofing detection as a causal sequential evidence-modeling problem, using uncertainty-normalized residual evidence to model the local evolution, excess, and accumulated persistence of GNSS–motion inconsistency for robust detection of continuous and subtle spoofing in autonomous driving.
